editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: JustMarkets is a legit, CySEC-regulated broker with 13 years of operation and a Pro account offering 0.1 pip spreads with zero commission — pricing that genuinely undercuts most competitors in 2026. The five-licence regulatory portfolio looks impressive on paper, but only CySEC qualifies as Tier-1 oversight while the majority of global clients land on FSA Seychelles with zero investor compensation. The 1:3000 leverage marketed on offshore entities is not a feature — it is a risk amplifier targeting traders in emerging markets who have not yet learned to respect position sizing. Crypto deposit options and 16+ payment methods make access easy from markets with limited banking infrastructure. Withdrawal reports are generally positive but the limited Trustpilot sample makes large-scale independent verification difficult. Not a scam, not on any warning list, and the CySEC licence provides genuine EU legitimacy — but primarily an offshore broker with competitive pricing that experienced traders can exploit while beginners get exploited by the leverage.
